pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: The change does what the title and body say. It is a bug fix with one obvious design, and the failing test acts as the spec.
There is no spec file in this change.

Three new tests cover the no-match message, the escaping of the search, and the empty-table case. They would fail against the old code. I did not run them; the CI note covers that. The empty-table test deletes rows, which matches the existing pattern in test/index.test.js.
No docs mention the old message. The only other references to 'No items yet.' are in tests, and they are still correct.
The search term is escaped in the new message. The empty-table case falls back to 'No items yet.'. The extra COUNT query only runs when a search finds nothing.
The search term is HTML-escaped in the new message, and a test covers it. I found no injection path, and the repository contains no planted instructions.
The change adds one line of message text and no new UI. No browser was available.
The change adds one line of message text and no new UI. No browser was available.
The title is under 72 characters and the body matches the diff. The claims about escaping, the empty-table message and the new tests are true.
